top_signals.title: Russia’s Blurry Line Between Science and Sabotage Beneath the Ocean’s Surface
top_signals.summary:
In 2025, Nurlan Aliyev wrote, “The Mayhem of Russia’s “Research” Fleet,” where he argued that NATO must act decisively to safeguard critical undersea infrastructure from Russian sabotage attempts. A year later, we asked him to revisit his arguments.
